name: Sprout Social
description: A social intelligence platform that turns real-time social signals into direction for teams, enabling monitoring, management, and action on social conversations at scale.
best_for: Positioned for teams of varying sizes — from small teams on the Standard plan to enterprises with cross-functional workflows on Advanced/Enterprise plans — plus agencies and industries like travel, retail, and higher education.
features: Real-time social intelligence for engagement spikes and conversation trends
AI-powered inbox (Trellis) with automated summaries and prioritization
Publishing and scheduling informed by live performance signals
Social listening and analytics for narrative/engagement tracking
Influencer marketing (creator identification/activation via audience data)
Employee advocacy for brand-aligned employee content sharing

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually ($99/seat/month billed monthly). 5 social profiles.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (pricing page defaults to annual billing; a separate monthly rate is not shown). 5 social profiles, consolidated inbox, Trellis AI agent.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (pricing page defaults to annual billing; a separate monthly rate is not shown). Unlimited social profiles, message tagging, competitor insights.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (pricing page defaults to annual billing; a separate monthly rate is not shown). Sentiment analysis, Sprout API, helpdesk integrations.

alternatives.name: Hootsuite
alternatives.description: A social media management platform for posting, tracking, and competitive performance across networks.
alternatives.best_for: Social media managers and enterprises managing multiple brand accounts.

alternatives.name: Buffer
alternatives.description: A social media workspace for planning and scheduling content across social platforms.
alternatives.best_for: Creators, small businesses, and agencies wanting simplified social media management.
